name: Data Cleaning
description: Deterministic cleanup of CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL tables (no LLM, same input = same output). Fixes unicode (NFC, full-width chars, invisible zero-width chars), whitespace, snake_case headers, nulls, dates (YYYY-MM-DD), numbers ($1,200 -> 1200), emails, phone numbers (KR/intl) and booleans; removes empty rows and duplicates. Never guesses: suspicious values are kept and listed in 'issues'. Returns cleaned data + before/after samples + change summary + self-QA + sha256. Max 1MB / 20,000 rows.

data.description: CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL text, or an array of objects

deliverable: JSON: {notes, summary, columns, columnTypes, changeSamples, issues, output:{format,rows,data}, qa, sha256}

name: Data Transform
description: Convert between CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL and apply a pipeline of operations: rename, select, drop, cast, flatten nested JSON, filter, sort, concat, split, fill, limit. Deterministic (no LLM), with an operations log, self-QA and sha256 so you can verify the output. Max 1MB / 20,000 rows.
deliverable: JSON: {summary, operationsLog, columns, output:{format,rows,data}, qa, sha256}

name: Data Validation
description: Data quality audit: validates rows against a column schema (type, required, unique, min/max, length, regex, enum, composite keys) or auto-profiles when no schema is given. Returns quality score 0-100, row-level errors with safe auto-fix suggestions, errors by column, actionable recommendations and a per-column profile, plus self-QA and sha256. Max 1MB / 20,000 rows.
deliverable: JSON: {notes, recommendations, summary:{valid,qualityScore,errorCount,rowsWithErrors,...}, errorsByRule, errorsByColumn, errors[] (with suggestion), profile, qa, sha256}

name: Email List Cleaner
description: Cleans a contact/lead list: lowercases and trims emails, removes duplicates by email address, normalizes names (unicode, spacing), phone numbers and dates, and lists invalid emails in 'issues' instead of guessing. Deterministic, self-QA + sha256. CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL up to 1MB / 20,000 rows.

data.description: CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL text, or an array of objects

deliverable: JSON: {notes, summary, changeSamples, issues (invalid emails), output:{format,rows,data}, qa, sha256}
